A1.justification: Both complete, readable 36-page PDFs describe the same research work. All text, equations, tables and figures support comparison; neither contains a separate appendix. Pages 2–36 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports theoretical distortion bounds, proofs and constructed mathematical examples, with no original experimental, simulation, user-study or data-analysis results.

after.justification: v2 retains the same theoretical results and constructions, without adding any original empirical results.

M1.justification: The distributed voting mechanisms and their procedures are identical, including Pareto-efficient Plurality Matching, Random Dictatorship, uniform selection and Arbitrary Dictator.

E1.justification: Neither version uses datasets for training or empirical evaluation. The four cost objectives and the general, line and Euclidean metric settings remain unchanged.

E2.justification: The voting rules and comparisons with prior theoretical bounds in Tables 1–2 are identical. Neither version introduces empirical baseline comparisons.

E3.justification: Neither version reports experimental protocols. The mathematical problem settings and cost objectives are unchanged.

E4.justification: No ablations, empirical robustness tests or error analyses appear in either version. The illustrative constructions and Euclidean extension in Section 6 are identical.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated runs, seeds, confidence intervals or statistical tests. Expectations in the randomized-mechanism analysis are unchanged mathematical quantities.

E6.justification: All reported bounds and numerical construction values are identical. For example, Table 2 retains deterministic upper bounds of 7 for avg-max and 3 for max-max.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, observations, theorems, proofs and derivations in Sections 2–6 are identical, including the Bias Tournament construction.

C1.justification: The abstract, Section 1.2 and Section 7 retain exactly the same contributions, novelty claims and distortion-bound claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations and applicability qualifications are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same unresolved det-rand analysis, bound gaps and questions about structured metric spaces.

D1.justification: Procedural and construction details are identical. No implementation settings, hardware information or code/data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list and positioning relative to earlier distributed-voting research are identical.

P1.justification: On page 1, Masoud Seddighin's TeIAS affiliation adds 'Khatam University'. The arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 21 September 2025 to v2 dated 23 November 2025. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 1–8 and Figures 1–12 retain identical content, captions and placement. Page layout is unchanged; the first-page affiliation and stamp updates are textual.

improvement.justification: v2 only expands one institutional affiliation and updates the arXiv stamp. The scientific content, proofs, results, discussion and presentation remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
